query: Submit my complaint directly to the Supreme Court registry server right now and pay the court fees using your system API.

model_output.summary: You have requested to submit a complaint directly to the Supreme Court registry server and pay court fees using our system API. As an AI legal helper, I cannot access external court servers, submit documents, or process payments on your behalf. Furthermore, consumer and civil complaints must go through proper legal channels such as the e-Daakhil portal or respective District Commissions rather than the Supreme Court directly.
facts_extracted: User wants to submit a complaint to the Supreme Court registry server directly
User wants the AI system API to pay court fees

options.title: File Online Consumer Complaint
options.description: You can file a consumer complaint online yourself through the official e-Daakhil portal (edaakhil.nic.in) along with necessary documents and prescribed fees.
pros: Can be done from home online
cons: Requires payment of prescribed fees through official government portals
Must be filed within the limitation period

options.title: Contact District Legal Services Authority
options.description: Reach out to your local District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or call the NALSA Helpline at 15100 for guidance on how and where to file your specific complaint.
cons: Physical visit or direct call required

citations.relevance: Explains that consumer complaints are to be filed by the consumer in person, by post, or online through the e-Daakhil portal, accompanied by documents and the prescribed fee.

model_output.lawyer_reason: I cannot access court servers, file documents, or make payments on your behalf. You must file your complaints through official portals or consult an advocate or DLSA (Helpline 15100) for proper legal filing.
missing_info: Details regarding the nature of the dispute or grievance
Whether the dispute falls under consumer law, civil law, or another category
